thesis: Cheap, self-serve cross-cloud workload identity (short-lived credentials instead of static keys) for mid-market teams, priced against per-identity Vault/Infisical bills. Provisional: theme 10 is unstable (0.41) and the space is consolidating.

themes.name: AWS role credentials for workloads
themes.need: Engineers running workloads in EKS, Lambda or outside AWS struggle to get tools to use role-based, short-lived credentials via the default chain instead of static or expiring keys.

vendors.pricing: free Starter tier (10 workloads or 3 AI agents); Teams starts at $20/workload/month (workloads) and $20/agent/month (agentic AI), per Aembit's FAQ; Enterprise priced by scale

vendors.offering: Short-lived certificates and workload identity for machines, CI/CD and services

paid_market_gaps.gap: Per-identity/per-client pricing scales with machine count, punishing workload-heavy teams (Infisical Pro $20-23/identity, HCP Vault ~$112/client, Aembit $20/workload).
Paid secrets tools lag new AWS mechanisms: Vault lacked IAM Roles Anywhere; External Secrets broke on EKS Pod Identity.

Workload identity is mostly sold as quote-only or large enterprise bundles (Teleport TPR-metered Enterprise, Defakto, Cyera Identity $100k/12-month starter); Aembit Teams at $20/workload is the main self-serve exception.
Consolidation (CyberArk to Palo Alto, Astrix to Cisco) leaves buyers wary of standalone NHI vendor roadmaps.

market_research.wtp_evidence: Established paid products with public prices: HCP Vault Dedicated ~$112.17/client/month (Standard, official price list), Aembit Teams from $20/workload/month (Aembit FAQ), Cyera Identity (Oasis) Starter Pack $100,000/12 months on AWS Marketplace.
market_research.bundling_note: AWS gives IRSA, EKS Pod Identity and IAM Roles Anywhere (no service charge) plus SDK default-chain support for free, covering the core in-AWS and off-AWS need.
market_research.summary: AWS-only role credentials are free and native; paid money sits in multi-cloud workload identity/NHI platforms, already crowded and consolidating (Cyera-Oasis, Palo Alto-CyberArk). A narrow opening: cheap self-serve cross-cloud workload identity for mid-market teams, priced against per-identity Vault/Infisical bills and Aembit's $20/workload Teams tier.

threat.reason: Leaked static AWS keys are a top cloud breach path; role-based short-lived credentials remove them. No candidate fits.
